description: ONE fantasy CUTLASSFISH / ribbonfish swimming RIGHT, incredibly LONG NARROW SILVER RIBBON body making a gentle S curve horizontally. Body width only 5-7 pixels except small angular pointed head at RIGHT. Length-to-thickness ratio at least TEN to ONE. At LEFT the ribbon narrows to ONE long needle-like pointed tail, NO forked tail and no tail fin. Thin continuous dorsal ridge made of tiny violet crystal triangles. Bright silver body with indigo lower edge and THREE cyan-violet angular crack bands. Body is connected and flexible, like a living curved silver sword blade. Closed small toothy mouth, one normal yellow eye. Crisp native 96x64 pixel art, controlled rich 3-tone shading, selective dark outline, entire fish inside transparent margins, no scenery, text or particles.
